description: A wire basket sits on the tabletop with a small metal tray inside it holding several colorful plastic utensils. The left hand stays resting on the table while the right hand reaches into the basket, grips a green utensil from the tray, lifts it out, and then lowers and releases the utensils onto the tabletop in front of the basket, spreading them into a small loose pile as the right hand continues adjusting them.
